description: Open-source git forge with GitHub Actions-compatible CI, pull requests, an MCP server and AI agent guardrails, running entirely on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, R2 and Containers.
rules: Diffinery runs GitHub Actions workflow files from .github/workflows/ (or .diffinery/workflows/); check docs/actions/compatibility.md for every known difference before assuming GitHub behaviour.
Hosted runners are Linux x64 Ubuntu 24.04 containers with 4 vCPU and 12 GiB by default; macOS, Windows and Arm jobs need self-hosted runners started with `diffinery runner`.
Git works over HTTPS only, with a Diffinery token as the password; there is no SSH.
The REST API is GitHub-compatible at https://<host>/api/v3 and GraphQL at https://<host>/api/graphql, so gh and Octokit work with the instance as a GitHub Enterprise host.
AI agents should use their own agent account and token; they cannot push or merge to protected branches unless a branch rule allows it, and their pull requests need a person's approval.
Diffinery is self-hosted on your own Cloudflare account (Workers Paid plan); deploy with scripts/setup.sh as described in docs/self-hosting/deploy.md.
